paragraphs: Kereah, ‘the bald one.’ Ben Azzai said, ‘All Israel's sages are before me like a garlic peel, except this bald one.’ This means R' Akiva, or R' Elazar ben Azarya, or an old man whose name this was. See R' Yehoshua ben Korha.
